title: Forfeited rewards from emergencyWithdraw stranded in contract
description: emergencyWithdraw zeros user.amount and returns principal but does not credit the user's forfeited pending rewards (user.amount * accRewardPerShare / 1e18 - user.rewardDebt) back to rewardBudget. Those tokens sit idle in the contract with no recovery path (no sweep function), causing rewardToken.balanceOf(this) > rewardBudget + totalDebt drift. totalDebt() view also misreports.
remediation: Add forfeited pending back into rewardBudget (and re-derive rewardRate / windowEnd), or expose an owner-only drift recovery.
